_readme: Preceptor NCLEX-RN (com.preceptor.nclex) — 50% price cut, Oct 2026. No product IDs listed: store_prices.py discovers the real 3-month/6-month subscriptions live from each store (iOS: subscriptionPeriod THREE_MONTHS/SIX_MONTHS; Android: ACTIVE base plans with billingPeriodDuration P3M/P6M). Known current prices per LAUNCH.md as of this cut: nclexrn_6month = US$149.99, nclexrn_3month = US$99.99 — this script computes 74.99 and 49.99 and will fail loudly if what it discovers live doesn't match that shape.
